sourceFile: 61. BRS-161014  Report checking reason NG separate VP+CD_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has usable rows but incorrectly merges distinct tests and conditions into one changed factor.
issues: Changed factor combines LED UV, VP thickness, jig run count, and VP mold comparisons.
Baseline Normal LED UV is not valid for VP thickness or VP mold outcomes.
Sheet 21.9 appears to be a separate root-cause check from sheet 15.9 validation tests.
Some cited rows are absent from provided context or are header/image-style evidence only.
Outcome grouping mixes defect rates, tension, peak checks, and bond-line checks without clear test grouping.
requiredUserQuestions: Should sheets 21.9 and 15.9 be separate review cases?
correctionPlan: Split changed factors by test: LED UV peak, VP thickness, jig run count, bond line, and VP mold.
Assign baselines only where rows show a direct normal/test comparison.
Separate or justify 21.9 mold NG-rate results from 15.9 improvement tests.
Remove header/image-only metrics unless citeable result rows are available.
Keep date, line, test number, and condition as subgroup keys.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist partly, but grouping and header-only citations are not sufficient for final evidence.
